name: @nocobase/plugin-mcit-data-editor
description: A NocoDB-style spreadsheet editor for NocoBase. Provides intuitive inline editing, bulk operations, advanced filtering, and multiple view modes (grid, form, kanban, calendar).
description.zh-CN: NocoBase 的 NocoDB 风格电子表格编辑器。提供直观的内联编辑、批量操作、高级过滤和多种视图模式（网格、表单、看板、日历）。
